Here are 10 things I learned on Day 1 of @Alibaba.com ’s CoCreate 2026 ✨: 1️⃣ AI is changing how products go from idea to market. Product research, sourcing, supplier discovery, and even parts of product development are getting faster. 2️⃣ Accio was one of the biggest things that caught my attention. Alibaba.com is using AI to make B2B sourcing more conversational and help businesses research products, suppliers, and opportunities without doing everything manually. 3️⃣ Agent-driven e-commerce is coming. AI is moving beyond answering questions and toward actually helping businesses complete tasks and make decisions. 4️⃣ Supply-chain transparency matters more than ever. Businesses need better visibility into where products come from, who they’re working with, and what’s happening throughout the sourcing process. 5️⃣ Launching a product is only step one. The real challenge is turning that product into a recognizable, scalable brand. 6️⃣ Cash flow can determine how fast you grow. Payment terms, financing, and working capital are just as important as generating sales. 7️⃣ Creators are becoming business owners. The creator economy is moving beyond sponsorships into creators launching products, brands, communities, and companies of their own. 8️⃣ Social commerce is only getting bigger. TikTok Shop, creators, paid media, and AI are continuing to shorten the distance between discovering something and actually buying it. 9️⃣ Automation is becoming a competitive advantage. The businesses that automate repetitive work can spend more time on strategy, customers, innovation, and growth. 🔟 Relationships still matter — even in an AI-driven world. Suppliers, founders, buyers, creators, and partners can all become part of your growth strategy. Sometimes one conversation really can lead to the next opportunity.
